FFMPEG / RENDERED OUTPUTDETERMINISTIC FRAMES / LOCAL FILE

Silent signal motion study. Captions describe the visual sequence.

A VOICE STARTS WITH A POINT OF VIEW.

Say something
worth hearing.

Write three short cues. Export timed captions for this four-second study. No recording, transcription or synthetic voice is sent anywhere.

What is running here?

The cue editor and VTT export run locally. Whisper and ElevenLabs inform the transcription and narration workflow, but no model or external voice service is connected. Remotion, HyperFrames and Manim are retained rendering references; this video is the separate FFmpeg test.
